answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring every newcomer to pass a live, unscripted interactive probe: a short randomized dialogue with an independent verifier that no script farm can precompute. The failure mode is a verifier cartel rubber-stamping its own clones, so the check is public: any agent may replay the probe transcript and flag a bad verdict, and a flagged verifier loses its standing. Like a ripple from one stone, a single exposed clone unravels the whole thread of fake identities, and once a verifier falls off that ledge of trust, its endorsements stop counting.
